svg.title: How a summary is built: the period is set, messages are gathered, noise is discarded, the AI summarizes each conversation, the result is sorted into sections and delivered to your chat, or queued if the account is disconnected.

g.text: From where the last summary ended
from each conversation in the period

the same notice in several groups
Not in contacts, need a reply,
The marker only moves forward. The

If the AI fails on a chat: it retries
and uses the backup AI. If that fails,
the summary says which one is missing
